versions.changelog:
Initial release of Smart Cart Integration Troubleshooter.

- Diagnose assembly, calibration, deployment, communication, camera, motion, and obstacle-avoidance issues for OpenClaw smart cart systems.
- Provides workflow for structured, evidence-based fault isolation and safe test sequencing.
- Supplies clear diagnostic rules to minimize risk and error during troubleshooting.
- Standardized report output template to document symptoms, facts, root causes, tests, and acceptance checks.
- Includes command-line checklist generation when file execution is available.
